source: 선택한 {{1}}는 같은 회차에서 {{3}}의 반환값이 양수이면 {{5}}를 처리한 뒤 {{7}}를 호출합니다. 유효한 fence fd에 Read 준비가 보고되고 요청 타이머의 기한도 지난 경우, {{9}}가 마지막 {{11}} 항목을 제거하면 {{13}}으로 {{15}}를 소멸시키며, 소멸자는 {{17}}을 통해 dispatcher 등록을 제거합니다. 이어서 {{19}}는 별도로 {{21}}를 호출하고, 이 함수는 {{23}}를 설정한 뒤 {{25}}를 발행하므로 기한 경과만으로 {{27}}이 먼저 호출되었다고 판정할 수 없습니다. 다른 fence가 남아 타이머가 여전히 등록되어 있고 만료 상태라면 뒤의 {{29}}에서 {{31}}이 실행될 수 있습니다.
prior_translation: The selected {{1}} processes {{5}} and then calls {{7}} if the return value of {{3}} is positive in the same iteration. If Read readiness is reported for a valid fence fd and the request timer's deadline has also passed, {{9}} destroys {{15}} using {{13}} when it removes the last {{11}} entry, and the destructor removes the dispatcher registration through {{17}}. Then {{19}} separately calls {{21}}, which sets {{23}} and then emits {{25}}, so the passage of the deadline alone does not establish that {{27}} was called first. If another fence remains and the timer is still registered and expired, {{31}} may execute during the subsequent {{29}}.
validated_native_translation: In the selected {{1}}, if {{3}} returns a positive value, it processes {{5}} during the same iteration. It then calls {{7}} regardless of the poll result. If read readiness is reported for a valid fence fd and the request timer's deadline has also passed, then when {{9}} removes the last {{11}} entry, it destroys the {{15}} using {{13}}, and the destructor removes the dispatcher registration through {{17}}. Subsequently, {{19}} separately calls {{21}}, which sets {{23}} and then emits {{25}}, so the elapsed deadline alone does not establish that {{27}} was called first. If another fence remains and the timer is still registered and expired, {{31}} may run in the subsequent {{29}}.
